{{dablink|For the similarly named ship owned by [[Bayle Domon]], see ''[[Spray]]''. For other uses of the word "white," see [[White]].}}
The '''''White Spray''''' is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' soarer with two raked masts.{{ref|{{twotc}}, White Spray}}  The ship belongs to Clan [[Shodein]].

==Crew==
*[[Derah din Selaan Rising Wave]] - [[Sailmistress]]
*[[Taval din Chanai Nine Gulls]] - [[Windfinder]]

==Activities==
''White Spray'' carried [[Zaida din Parede Blackwing]] and her [[Swordmaster]] to [[Aringill]].{{ref/book|6|5}} He then sails to [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]] with [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]].{{ref/book|6|17}} Both [[Erian Boroleos]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]] try to board ''White Spray'', but are denied because they can [[channel]]. Egwene is even dumped into the river when she tries to board.{{ref/book|6|27}}{{ref/book|6|32}} [[Rand al'Thor]] meets with the Sea Folk on ''White Spray''.{{ref/book|7|34}}
